content.text: {"id": "mm7048e1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the estimated number of new HIV infections among MSM was 25,100 in 2010 and 23,100 in 2019"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "infections significantly decreased from 7,500 to 5,100 among White MSM"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 68% of MSM with diagnosed HIV infection were virally suppressed."}]}, {"v": "continuous", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Black MSM (33) and Hispanic/Latino MSM (32) had higher median scores than did White MSM (26)."}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 68% of MSM with diagnosed HIV infection were virally suppressed."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "A lower percentage of Black MSM (83%) and Hispanic/Latino MSM (80%) with HIV had received a diagnosis than did White MSM (90%)."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "This analysis of national surveillance data found that"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the estimated number of new HIV infections among MSM was 25,100 in 2010 and 23,100 in 2019"}]}, {"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC analyzed data from three national surveillance systems"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "To assess changes in estimated HIV infections, the z-test was used to compare changes from 2010 to 2019"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Estimates from MMP were weighted to represent the population of adults with diagnosed HIV infection in the United States."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Estimates with a denominator sample size <30 were not reported."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Median scores with nonoverlapping 95% CIs were considered to be meaningfully different."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
